note: Single semantic contract for the repository-system surface. Section ORDINALS may change (the etalon line renumbers and inserts sections); the SEMANTIC contract below may not. Governance tests DERIVE their expectations from this manifest (number-agnostic heading regexes + required links/semantics/verbs), not from hardcoded ordinals. A section may be added freely; removing a required_section or required_semantics entry is a governance change that must update this manifest with a migration note, never a silent drift.
required_semantics: retired or failed states are preserved
